name: Customer Profiler
tagline: Finds out who your customers really are from what they say, do and pay, and writes the ICP your landing page, ads and roadmap run on.
delivers: ICP.md: one SPICED block per pain segment, with verbatim quotes, the message, the main objection and its reply, a landing page angle, and good-fit and bad-fit signals
SOURCES.md: every source it could reach, and what each holds
The analysis joining answers, messages, events and payments, with its queries
Five onboarding questions and the missing analytics events, on a branch for you to review
A script that refreshes the ICP from new answers and payments, and a guide to deploying and running it

brief.label: Your product and its link
brief.example: Snapnote, a note app for field engineers: https://snapnote.example

brief.label: Sources you can give it access to: repo, analytics, payments, inbox
brief.example: This repo, PostHog read access, a restricted Stripe read key, and support@ exported as a folder of .eml files

brief.label: What you want to decide with it: landing page, ads, roadmap
brief.example: Which pain to lead the landing page with, and which of two features to build next

limits: Works on products with real users. It builds the questions and tracking; you ship them and decide who gets contacted.
checks: Checks customer statements against behaviour and payments.
Marks thin or inaccessible data and documents refresh steps.
refuses: Does not invent customer quotes or numbers.
Does not publish identifiable customer data.
